behavior.arguments: four 32-bit arguments: v in edi, rsi, rdx, rcx (rcx enters only as r8d); result leaves in eax, zero-extended
behavior.branch_order: v0 = (v == 0 ? 11 : v); v = min(v0, hi); v = max(v, lo); v = min(v, 12); v = max(v, 5); return v. The chain is stated literally, not as a true clamp: when lo > hi the min-then-max order matters
behavior.bsr_undefined_inputs: rule defined only when low 32 bits of rsi, rdx, and (rsi-1) are all nonzero, equivalently low32(rsi) not in {0, 1} and low32(rdx) != 0; bsr of zero is architecturally undefined and the bytes contain no zero guards

edges.order_matters_7_8_8_0: 5 (lo=4 > hi=2, so the literal chain, not a clamp, decides)

behavior.hi_derivation: bsr(rsi-1) xor 0x1f == 31 - bsr(rsi-1) for bsr in 0..31; (31 - rcx) - (31 - bsr(rsi-1)) == bsr(rsi-1) - rcx (mod 2^32)
behavior.lo_formula: min(bsr(low32(rsi))+1, bsr(low32(rdx))+2), via cmova (moves exactly when esi is above edx)
behavior.output_shape: 32-bit result in eax (v0 zero-defaulted to 11, then min/max ladder to the [5, 12] band, with the lo>hi order caveat)

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

function.sibling_not_bound: 0x556e9e0 (same ladder shape, different inputs; needs an explicit parent decision)
